exercises.title: Why RE 1 — where a requirement defect costs the most
exercises.problemHtml:
The cost of fixing a requirement defect grows with every phase it survives undetected (Boehm’s "1:10:100" observation; the lesson uses ×1 requirements, ×5 design, ×10 coding, ×20 testing, ×100+ production). Order the phases from the cheapest to the most expensive place to fix the same defect.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Chi phí sửa một lỗi yêu cầu tăng theo mỗi pha nó "sống sót" (quan sát 1:10:100 của Boehm). Sắp các pha từ nơi sửa rẻ nhất tới đắt nhất.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

exercises.title: Why RE 2 — put a number on late defects
exercises.problemHtml:
Use the multipliers of the lesson: requirements ×1, design ×5, coding ×10, testing ×20, production ×100. Fixing a defect during requirements costs 0.5 hour. Write function cost(foundIn) that returns the hours to fix one requirement defect found in a phase (lower-case phase names; unknown phase ⇒ null), and function totalCost(defects) where defects is an object { phase: count }; unknown phases are ignored.

Then set SAVED_BY_REVIEW to the hours saved if a 2-hour requirements review had found, during requirements, the 6 defects that a project later found in testing (4) and production (2) — review time included.

Requirements

  • cost("testing") = 10; totalCost({ coding: 2, production: 1 }) = 60.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Hệ số: requirements ×1, design ×5, coding ×10, testing ×20, production ×100; sửa ở pha yêu cầu tốn 0,5 giờ. Viết cost(foundIn) và totalCost(defects); rồi tính SAVED_BY_REVIEW: số giờ tiết kiệm nếu một buổi review 2 giờ đã bắt ngay ở pha yêu cầu 6 lỗi mà dự án về sau mới thấy ở kiểm thử (4) và production (2) — đã trừ 2 giờ review.

Yêu cầu

  • cost("testing") = 10; totalCost({ coding: 2, production: 1 }) = 60.
hintsJson: Lập bảng hệ số; cost = 0,5 × hệ số.
Tiết kiệm = chi phí về sau − (giờ review + chi phí sửa ngay ở pha yêu cầu).

exercises.title: Why RE 4 — benefits and evidence
exercises.problemHtml:
Benefits of a high-quality requirements process: fewer defects, less rework, more accurate estimates, shared understanding between customer and team, and a baseline to test against. Industry studies (e.g. Standish CHAOS) consistently rank incomplete requirements, lack of user involvement and changing requirements among the top causes of project failure.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

# Why RE 4 — benefits and evidence — answer key

1. A manager says "requirements work slows us down". Best reply?Quản lý nói "làm yêu cầu làm chậm dự án". Trả lời tốt nhất?
   Answer: c) Skipping it slows you down later: defects found late cost many times more and cause rework.
   Rework is the hidden cost.VI: Làm lại là chi phí ẩn.

2. Which is NOT a benefit of good requirements practices?Đâu KHÔNG phải lợi ích của thực hành yêu cầu tốt?
   Answer: c) Guaranteed zero defects
   They reduce defects, they do not eliminate them.VI: Giảm lỗi, không xoá hết lỗi.

3. Industry studies rank which causes of project failure highest?Nghiên cứu ngành xếp nguyên nhân thất bại nào cao nhất?
   Answer: a) Incomplete requirements, lack of user involvement, changing requirements
   Fuzzy problems kill more projects than hard solutions.VI: Vấn đề mơ hồ giết nhiều dự án hơn lời giải khó.
